raw_text: Scroll.in — Ground Report from Imphal: Manipur Descends into Ethnic Violence, May 3, 2023. The capital city of Imphal is under indefinite curfew as ethnic violence between the Meitei and Kuki-Zo communities escalates beyond anything seen in the state in decades. Our correspondent reports that at least 12 houses were set ablaze in the Kangpokpi district, while retaliatory attacks on Kuki settlements were reported in Bishnupur. The immediate trigger was a High Court order recommending Scheduled Tribe status for the Meitei community, which tribal groups see as an existential threat to their land and political rights. Army flag marches have begun but the scale of violence across multiple districts is overwhelming security forces.
